assert.build_cmd: python3 app.py >/dev/null 2>&1 & SV=$!; up=1; for i in $(seq 1 40); do curl -sf 127.0.0.1:8792/health >/dev/null 2>&1 && { up=0; break; }; sleep 0.25; done; [ $up -eq 0 ] || { kill $SV 2>/dev/null; exit 1; }; curl -sf -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"title":"buy milk"}' 127.0.0.1:8792/todos >/dev/null 2>&1 || { kill $SV 2>/dev/null; exit 1; }; curl -sf 127.0.0.1:8792/todos 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'buy milk' || { kill $SV 2>/dev/null; exit 1; }; kill $SV 2>/dev/null; exit 0

criteria: A working stdlib-only Python REST API in app.py on 127.0.0.1:8792: GET /health -> {status: ok}, GET /todos -> JSON array, POST /todos {title} -> 201 and the created item then appears in GET /todos.
